comments: Searches webhooks with the specified criteria and pagination.

params.name: description
comments: (Optional) The description of the webhook to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

params.name: numberOfResults
comments: (Optional) The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

params.name: orderBy
comments: (Optional) The field to order the results by. Supported values: description, id, insertInstant, url.

params.name: startRow
comments: (Optional) The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

params.name: tenantId
comments: (Optional) The tenant Id to restrict the results to.

params.name: url
comments: (Optional) The URL of the webhook to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.
